surveys.title: EU-OSHA Workers' Exposure Survey on cancer risk factors
surveys.where: Germany, Ireland, Spain, France, Hungary and Finland, pooled
surveys.measure: Share of workers probably exposed in their last working week (any level)

source.citation: Cavet M, Matsushima A, Sanchez A. Occupational cancer risk factors in Europe - Overview of the findings of the Workers' Exposure Survey. European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA), Luxembourg: Publications Office of the European Union, 2025.
source.licence: 'Reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged.' (c) European Agency for Safety and Health at Work, 2025; third-party photos or other material need separate permission.

caveats: Telephone survey of 24,402 workers; exposure assessed from the tasks each worker described, with the OccIDEAS expert system.
Fieldwork ran from September to February, so exposure to the sun is probably understated.
The six countries are pooled; the survey gives no country figures.

surveys.title: Australian Work Exposures Study
surveys.measure: Share of survey respondents in each industry probably exposed in their current job

source.citation: Carey RN, et al. Occupational exposure to carcinogens in Australia. Occup Environ Med 2014;71:55–62; Safe Work Australia. Australian Work Exposures Study: carcinogen exposure by industry (2016).
source.licence: CC BY 3.0 AU (Safe Work Australia reports)

caveats: Telephone survey of 5,023 workers; industry figures are shares of the survey respondents working in that industry.
National estimates are shown only where the study extrapolated them.
